## 3. Projection for `Qwen3.8-27B-Fable-Distill-OptiQ-4.5bpw-mixed` (vs its shipped native16 + fused_v1 + joint_v1)

Method of PROBE.md §4 with this run's matched times: fixed = the pick's measured round (MTP ON) or token (MTP OFF) minus 16 × this run's native16 attention; each TQ4 column swaps in 16 × its attention.
